name: Trace the Pi Coding Agent with Langfuse - Langfuse
description: The plugin listens to Pi's core lifecycle events and sends every user prompt to Langfuse as its own trace: Agent turns: one trace per user prompt, with all turns of a Pi session grouped under one session ID.
